string.text: A stationary anomaly-field monitor. Install it inside a field, with one scanner per cluster. The field's existing PDA marker turns green when a natural artifact is present. A golden marker means an unstable signal: there may or may not be an artifact. Readings are renewed after emissions. No maintenance is required, but a deployed scanner cannot be recovered. To destroy it, aim at the scanner and hold the use key for five seconds.
Install the scanner inside an anomaly field. The placement point in front of you must also be inside its boundary.
This anomaly field already has a scanner.
Installation failed. The scanner remains in your backpack.
Scanner installed. Readings are shown on the field's PDA marker.
Destroy: hold the use key for 5 seconds
Scanner destroyed. Field monitoring has ended.

A stationary device monitors natural artifacts and reports to the anomaly field's existing PDA marker. Enter the field and select "Install" in your inventory. Only one scanner can be installed per field; isolated anomalies are unsuitable. 

%c[255,0,255,0]Green marker%c[default] — a natural artifact is present. Once it is collected, a working scanner restores the marker's usual color. 
%c[default]Usual color — no natural artifact is present. 
%c[255,188,138,53]Gold marker%c[default] — the device is malfunctioning: an artifact may or may not be present. Check the field in person. This signal lasts until the next emission, even if the artifact is collected. 

Readings are updated after every emission. No batteries are required. An installed scanner cannot be recovered. To destroy it, get within 3 metres, aim at the device, hold the use key for 5 seconds and confirm.
